reading.title: Your reading of the book
reading.description: What you read in the book before seeing the overview (the view of the book the assistant proposes): your provisional central idea and its movements. It is your hypothesis; each pericope will test it.
reading.editLabel: Edit your reading of the book
reading.emptyTitle: You have not written your reading of the book yet
reading.empty: Before seeing the overview, write what you think the book says and the movements it advances in. It does not have to be final: it is what you will test against the text.
reading.noIdea: You have not written your central idea yet.

oldNote.title: You have an earlier note
oldNote.body: It no longer counts as your reading of the book. Move it into the framing: it is copied as is, and you correct and confirm it.
oldNote.action: Move your note into the framing
oldNote.missing: The note's text was not found.

noteDialog.title: Your earlier note
noteDialog.intoIdea: It was copied as is into «Central idea». Cut it, move it to another field or delete it: nothing is saved until you confirm.
noteDialog.ideaTaken: Your central idea already has text and was left untouched. Your note stays here so you can copy what helps.
noteDialog.truncated: The note is longer than the field: its beginning was copied ({{max}} characters).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The reasoned list of works you will work with (the state of the art): what the work requires, the candidates and the ones you approve, with your reason.
sources.empty: In the state of the art you set what the work requires, gather candidates from your library, the syllabus and the catalog, and approve works with your reason.
sources.manual_one: {{count}} added by hand, before the state of the art.
sources.manual_other: {{count}} added by hand, before the state of the art.
sources.incomplete_one: {{count}} requirement is missing the figure needed to measure it.
sources.incomplete_other: {{count}} requirements are missing the figure needed to measure them.
sources.accepted_one: {{count}} requirement accepted as met on purpose.
sources.accepted_other: {{count}} requirements accepted as met on purpose.
sources.toAcquireNote: An approved work can stay «to acquire»: approving decides on the work, not whether it is already in your library.

table.title: The pericope table
table.description: A pericope is each unit of the text that is preached whole. For each one you see its study, what you noted in your reading and its sermon.

reading.annotateLabel: Note in your reading what the study of {{label}} says

table.addOutside: Add a study outside the series
table.orStudy: If you would rather start with one pericope before dividing the book:
table.noSeriesTitle: You have not divided the book into pericopes yet
table.noSeries: The planner helps you divide it: you write your division first and then compare it with the overview. When the series is created, each pericope gets its study.
table.withoutSeries: You said the division is done without a series: your studies are below.
table.groupCounts: {{done}} of {{total}} studied · {{annotated}} noted in your reading

synthesis.title: Synthesis
synthesis.description: Test your central idea against what you noted from each pericope and revise it. Only your revised idea, while current, reaches the sermon.
synthesis.emptyTitle: The synthesis opens with your first note
synthesis.empty: When you finish a study, note whether it confirms, nuances or contradicts your reading of the book. That way your idea is tested while you work, not only at the end.
synthesis.stale: You changed your original idea after revising it: revise it again so it reaches the sermon.
synthesis.needsIdea: To revise your central idea, first write it in your reading of the book.

history.title: How your reading changed
history.description: Your original idea, what you noted from each study and your revised idea. Only your own words.
history.noOriginal: You did not write a central idea in your reading of the book.
history.noLog: You have not noted any study yet.
history.noRevision: You have not revised your central idea yet.
history.stale: This revision is out of date: you changed the original idea afterwards.
